statement: Houthi forces fire at least one ballistic missile, cruise missile, or armed drone that the Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted or destroyed, in an incident occurring between 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-08.
resolution: TRUE if a Saudi-led coalition statement, carried by the Saudi Press Agency or at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, Al Jazeera, reports such an interception dated between 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-08.
failure_condition: Houthi forces fire no missile or drone that the Saudi-led coalition intercepts or destroys between 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-08.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Armed clashes between Ethiopian federal forces and Tigrayan armed forces of any faction take place on at least one day between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, and BBC report fighting between Ethiopian federal forces and Tigrayan forces that occurred between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25; fighting dated earlier does not count.
failure_condition: No armed clash between Ethiopian federal forces and Tigrayan forces occurs between 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-25.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield closes at or above 5.35 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-23. Reference: 5.14 percent on the packet date.

failure_condition: Every DGS10 daily value between 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-23 is below 5.35 percent.
